overall: AG found the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to create and approve minutes for its 2016–2019 meetings, and reminded it of its duty to respond timely to complaints. Ordered minutes created, member training, and certification.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Economic Development Commission failed to create minutes for most of its meetings from 2016 through 2019.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to create and approve minutes for meetings it held between 2016 and 2019.

allegations.summary: Not raised in the complaint; the AG noted on its own that the Commission did not respond to the complaint as the Open Meeting Law requires.
allegations.key_passage: we note that the Commission did not respond to the complaint at issue here as required by the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Create minutes for its meetings held between 2016 and 2019 at which a quorum was present, to the best of its ability, and certify to the AG within 60 days of receipt of the letter.
Each Commission member must review the AG's Open Meeting Law training video on minutes and certify to the AG within 60 days of receipt of the letter.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law; similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate.
remedy_passage: We order the Commission to create minutes for its meetings held between 2016 and 2019 at which a quorum of the Commission was present.
